@op.games.tictactoe.why core.operation
    impl=matrix
    semantics=action
    action=ttt.why
    doc="Matrix mode: why the computer played its last move (win, block, center, a free square, or the best move), from what the rules and the chooser recorded on it."

@pat.games.tictactoe.m.why core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler|pls|hey]? why [$lang.why.did] you [$lang.why.act] [$lang.why.there]"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=ttt.why"
    kind=request
    priority=14
    example="Why did you play there?"
    canonical="Why did you play there?"
    example="Why did you pick that square?"

    match="[$lang.lead.filler|pls|hey]? why [$lang.why.place]"
